entries.title: Psalms 125:1
segments: A Song of degrees. They who trust in the LORD [shall be] like Mount Zion; it is not shaken, but remains forever.

entries.title: Psalms 125:2
segments: As the mountains [are] all around Jerusalem, so the LORD [is] all around His people from this time and forever.

entries.title: Psalms 125:3
segments: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest on the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands to iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 125:4
segments: Do good, O LORD, to the good, and to the upright in their hearts.

entries.title: Psalms 125:5
segments: And those who turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity; peace [shall be] on Israel.
